verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents an app marketplace with over 1,200 apps, plus developer support for publishing single-click apps to it, so merchants can extend their store from a first-party marketplace. The vetting or review process is not evidenced, and one hands-on user report calls the app ecosystem 'rather incomplete', which tempers the long-tail claim. Missing for 10: documentation of app vetting/certification, evidence of long-tail feature coverage by category, independent corroboration of marketplace breadth and quality.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can extend my store from a marketplace of vetted apps and extensions covering the long tail of features
